turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling SHARE. My name is Layla. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello I have a question about my loyalty balance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Can you tell me what happened?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My points were not added after a purchase yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I can explain how we can check the missing points.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be helpful.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We will need the transaction details and then the team can investigate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long does that usually take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The team will confirm the timeline after reviewing the case.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting SHARE. Have a lovely day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, you have reached SHARE. I am Amir. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to update my contact number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can guide you through that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I do it in the application?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can check the profile settings. The exact verification process may depend on your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else you would like help with?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have a great day and thank you for calling.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning. Thank you for calling SHARE. This is Noor speaking.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My card was not recognized at a store.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about the inconvenience. Could you describe what the cashier saw?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: There was a message saying the code could not be scanned.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I will explain the next steps you can try.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Open the app to check that your personal code is available and try refreshing it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will try it later.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If it still does not work, please contact us again for further help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling and have a nice day.
